pages.text: There are three paths: Hunger, Movement, and Darkness. Each can be leveled up to 15 levels based on experience points: level N costs N experience points. The first level is shared and unlocks the form.
pages.title: Three Paths

pages.text: $(thing)Hunger$(): the form consumes less hunger.$(br)$(thing)Movement$(): increased speed while in the form.$(br)$(thing)Darkness$(): improvement of the gaze while in the form.$(br2)The levels of the paths affect abilities: see the «Abilities» section.
